newsitem.title: USA: CBOE to list options on three stocks on Oct 7.
newsitem.headline: CBOE to list options on three stocks on Oct 7.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) said Monday it would list options on Arterial Vascular Engineering Inc, Donna Karan International Inc and Sodak Gaming Inc on October 7.
The CBOE said Arterial Vascular options will have opening strike prices of 22-1/2, 25 and 30, with initial expiration months of October, November, January and April.
The stock was up 1-3/4 at 27 Monday afternoon.
Genesis Trading Group LLC will be the Designated Primary Market maker (DPM).
Donna Karan options will have opening strike prices of 22-1/2, 25 and 30. The stock was down 3/4 at 23-1/4 Monday afternoon.
Initial expirations will be in October, November, January and April. The options will trade in the Hewlett-Packard Co crowd.
For Sodak Gaming, opening strikes will be 20, 22-1/2 and 25. The stock was up 1-1/8 at 22-1/2 Monday afternoon.
Initial expirations will be in October, November, February and May. TFM Investment Group will be the DPM. --Derivatives desk, 312-408-8750/E-mail
